rejected_experiments.reason: Correcting the heading sign alone made the 180-degree symmetric E2E publish; baseline and exact_v1 refuse. Fixed by phasing the existing uniform yaw grid with the measured heading, with unchanged acceptance gates.
Only small CPU savings; first-lock wall 02/09/14 increases from 4.554/4.350/8.031 s to 7.025/5.677/15.831 s; not selected.
Nearest-neighbor certificate preserves correspondence and E2E tests, but CPU worsens in 02 and 14; source and added certificate tests reverted, experiment preserved.

regression_evidence.seed_overlap_test_change: A one-bin measured-heading grid overlaps two rather than three seeds after a sector change. Still exactly one new full registration.

retained_changes: Complete exact place scores at both observation scales before fused heading selection; same final candidate count and gates
Invert measured polar-image yaw to obtain the query-to-reference pose seed; phase the existing uniform grid to preserve equally precise symmetric competitors
unchanged: Registration objectives and numerical acceptance gates
Installed binaries, simulator, FAST_LIO and ROS interfaces
interpretation.half_core_status: Unmet across the suite and moving negative. Position 09 meets the whole-episode budget; 14 does not. CPU divided by input span includes search; last-10-second tracking excludes initial search.
interpretation.precision_status: No universal accuracy improvement or exact equivalence established. Shared-time position RMSE at 13 increases 0.359 mm; maximum position error remains equivalent. Some rotation errors increase slightly. All individual differences retained.
interpretation.timing_scope: Single alternating serial A/B per position at four physical P cores, four registration threads, PASSIVE OpenMP, original 10 Hz due times. Not repeated timing statistics. No map loading, simulator, frontend or DDS costs.
remaining: Geometric solve and repeated negative-search cost
Residual map/local-fit errors, up to about 0.474 m in the fixed suite
